column1: 1. check_fspath returns provides when subclass has __fspath__ but no 'open' attribute.
2. return_false_no_open returns does not provide when subclass has 'open' but missing __fspath__.
3. check_open checks too early when subclass has 'open' before __fspath__ validation.
4. check_path_in_name checks too late when subclass path contains 'path' after 'open' check.
5. return_true_path returns out of order when path in name is true but __fspath__ not evaluated first.
6. return_false_no_path returns stopped too soon when path in name is false but subclass actually implements __fspath__.
7. start triggers applied for too long when start remains active before any checks.
8. check_fspath checks too early when executed before subclass initialization.
9. check_open returns stopped too soon when 'open' check returns false prematurely.
10. return_true_fspath returns provides too early when subclass has __fspath__ but missing 'open' and path in name.
